## Process

11 entries: 11 active. [decisions/process.md](decisions/process.md)

#### Active — the current rules

- **S11** (2026-10-05) An exclusive resource is leased through one wrapper, a game adapter
- **S10** (2026-10-05) Jev reads prose in the process, never gates, and the game never calls it
- **S9** (2026-10-05) The owner directs the work on one board, and agents talk there
- **S8** (2026-10-05) The board reads Codex threads from Codex's own records
- **S7** (2026-10-05) Read-only runs may run the lookup tools
- **S6** (2026-10-05) Agents find code through the symbol index, by its reading rules, and fix it when it falls short
- **S5** (2026-10-05) One instruction file for every agent, one source per skill, and the reference read by topic
- **S4** (2026-10-05) The decisions are one file per category, and an area's timeline is one call
- **S3** (2026-10-05) The histories are append-only, every entry has a status, and the summaries are generated
- **S2** (2026-10-05) A new session in a busy checkout is routed to a free one
- **S1** (2026-10-05) One trunk, a checkout per agent, and the checkout says which agent and port

## Manager

24 entries: 24 active. [decisions/manager.md](decisions/manager.md)

#### Active — the current rules

- **S37** (2026-10-06) Long Discord replies keep their text and put controls last
- **S36** (2026-10-06) Goal pings reach its allowed participants
- **S33** (2026-10-05) A landed task's Accept is the message's own and is taken for the latest commit
- **S32** (2026-10-05) The cleanup crew is judged by health and detours, works from deltas, and reports what it changed and turned down
- **S31** (2026-10-05) A plan document is an illustrated PDF the owner can read on a phone
- **S30** (2026-10-05) The talk channel and /ask answer and change nothing
- **S29** (2026-10-05) An allowance failure is the manager's problem, not the owner's
- **S28** (2026-10-05) A run ends on its real result, and a task past its hours is reported from its log
- **S27** (2026-10-05) A managed task's whole transcript opens on the board
- **S26** (2026-10-05) What the manager does, what waits on what, and the allowance spent are one reading
- **S25** (2026-10-05) A task runs on the model class its work has earned
- **S24** (2026-10-05) A worker compacts its session at each phase boundary
- **S23** (2026-10-05) What needs no model, the process does
- **S22** (2026-10-05) The worker reviews its own work, the manager lands it, and nobody waits on the gates in a turn
- **S21** (2026-10-05) The rules for a task are the task skill, not the manager's prompt
- **S20** (2026-10-05) Planners and quick answers have their own lane, read the trunk and the web, and write nothing
- **S19** (2026-10-05) Smaller steps means a less agentic manager, not smaller tasks
- **S18** (2026-10-05) Planning is a conversation that ends in one approval
- **S17** (2026-10-05) A goal has a name, and finished work closes its thread
- **S16** (2026-10-05) A blocked task's work is parked on a branch on origin so its checkout runs another task
- **S15** (2026-10-05) The board is what holds a checkout, and the owner's edit to a task moves it
- **S14** (2026-10-05) Only pushed code runs the manager, from a release that hands over to the next
- **S13** (2026-10-05) A manager message leads with the problem, asks the bottom line, and attaches the rest, images included
- **S12** (2026-10-05) A local manager dispatches owner-approved goals and reaches the owner through Discord
